## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## User impact

Explain the visible behavior change, compatibility impact, and any migration
steps.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] This change does not expose credentials, cookies, private URLs, or local
      user data.
- [ ] Authentication, IPC, filesystem, and process execution changes have been
      reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Third-party executable or dependency changes include version, integrity,
      and license updates where applicable.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant Windows behavior was manually verified, or the reason it was not
      verified is documented below.

## Screenshots or logs

Attach only redacted material. Never include Instagram cookies, `sessionid`
values, passwords, private media URLs, or personal account details.
